missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Оружие' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Опасно' is the short-form neuter predicate, and 'это' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Оружие' is the accusative direct object of 'держит'. As a neuter inanimate noun it keeps the nominative form. 'В руках' is prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Оружия' is the genitive singular after 'нет', marking absence. The neuter ending '-я' is required, and 'никакого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об оружии' uses the prepositional form 'оружии' after 'об'. The neuter ending '-и' marks the topic of discussion.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Оружием' is the instrumental form showing the means of threatening. The neuter ending is '-ем', and 'нам' is the dative target.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Оружие' is the accusative direct object of 'производит', unchanged from the nominative as a neuter noun. 'Современное' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В оружии' uses the prepositional form 'оружии' after 'в'. The neuter ending '-и' marks where the cartridges were absent.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Оружия' is the genitive singular required by 'без', marking absence of the weapon. The neuter ending is '-я'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Оружия' is genitive singular tied to the plural accusative 'виды'. The phrase 'виды оружия' means types of weapons, a useful collocation.

Strategic focus: Accusative with collective noun. 'Оружие' is the accusative direct object of 'несут'. Russian treats it as an uncountable neuter noun, so 'разное' agrees in the neuter singular even though many soldiers carry it.
